test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FIANCE’ is written as ‘NIFECA’ and ‘PLANT’ is written as ‘TPNLA’. How will ‘PRODUCT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/O-8dyIBISvx5o12SRtu7LEU3MrfmUur0K7yvnZtsglByfUu2KE50xGcq6Fq_nOEKo4KE6Pi8qp1t_qIoWZP27wlcEhkexo6SLy4EV_7f2vEMLUJBvfvnqxEzTXkOURl8Qxk2a4F4lUwkwpyJZID43g] 

‘FIANCE’ is written as ‘NIFECA’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c935e851e61829f06b2d9344d63d8d6fe87912984583cc80f3b37b5e1fe6cc3a.png] 

And,

‘PLANT’ is written as ‘TPNLA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc0f7a6da3359313942b84f940254e5fcde2976a467e52d3805084c73ad62e94.png] 

Similarly,

‘PRODUCT’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fe1cc3f8e4136e401b8b6a4a19bdfcfc94e567c08bcfbd0da59d0fc0e8419d9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"UTRPODC".**
